title: About that Modern Digital Dash
author: KaminKevCrew
issue_summary: Developer is creating a modern recreation of the rare JDM digital dashboard for the MK3 Supra using approximately 1,000 LEDs per cluster, with plans to manufacture and sell them.
key_takeaway: A custom digital dashboard is being developed that will be plug-and-play with factory wiring while also supporting CAN bus data from standalone ECUs, with each gauge able to independently select its data source.
searchable_text: About that Modern Digital Dash Developer is creating a modern recreation of the rare JDM digital dashboard for the MK3 Supra using approximately 1,000 LEDs per cluster, with plans to manufacture and sell them.
